pipeline.label: How we work
pipeline.title: A complete pipeline: data → models → systems → derivatives
pipeline.subtitle: Instead of multiplying one-off projects, we design a foundation that serves your platforms, course materials, publishing and future applications.

0.title: Map your content and data
0.body: We start from what you already have (databases, files, field notes, manuscripts, recordings, archives, business content) or we help you create a structured base when none exists yet. We clarify structures, uses, target formats and audiences.

1.title: Design a model usable in the long term
1.body: We design reusable data schemas (corpora, records, listings, learning content, catalogues, lexicons, etc.) and install them in manageable environments (MySQL/SQL, structured files, APIs, data stores). The goal: a stable, extensible and documented foundation.

2.title: Build the platform and tools
2.body: We develop the systems that leverage this foundation: platforms, back-offices, consultation interfaces, internal tools, e-commerce or business applications. When it makes sense, we also prepare the building blocks for mobile or desktop apps.

3.title: Derive books, resources and applications
3.body: From the same data, we produce books and workbooks, printable resources, interactive content and applications (mobile, web or desktop). Scripts (JSX, Java, C++, etc.) can automatically generate puzzles, quizzes, course materials or other derivatives.

weAre.title: Who we are

items.0: Design of data models for corpora, catalogues, lexicons, announcements or learning content.
items.1: Platforms and business tools: portals, member spaces, editorial back-offices, specialised e-boutiques.
items.2: Scripts and pipelines to books, workbooks, printable resources and interactive content.

items.0: Systems that are extensible, documented and designed to last (not throwaway one-shots).

items.2: Interfaces that truly serve their audiences: learners, researchers, teaching teams, families, communities.

method.label: How we work
method.title: A controlled pipeline: from raw material to systems and derivatives
method.subtitle: Rather than multiplying isolated projects, we build a data foundation that will support your platforms, printed materials, learning derivatives and future applications.

0.title: Map your content and data
0.body: We start from what you already have, or from what you want to produce: databases, files, field notes, course corpora, announcements, manuscripts, archives, business documentation. We clarify structures, uses, target formats and audiences.

1.title: Design a model usable in the long term
1.body: We design reusable data schemas (corpora, records, announcements, learning content, lexicons, catalogues, etc.) and put them into manageable formats (MySQL/SQL, JSON, APIs, etc.). The goal: a stable, extensible and documented foundation.

2.title: Build platforms and tools
2.body: We develop the main platform (portal, web application, internal tool, specialised e-boutique) and the necessary interfaces: content publishing, catalogue management, contributions, exports, user spaces, statistics.

3.title: Derive books, workbooks, materials and apps

tech.subtitle: We choose technologies based on your stakes: structuring, long-term durability, dissemination, derivation.

seo.description: Describe your project: corpora, platforms, books, tools or data systems. Batina Media helps you design models, platforms and derivatives that last.

hero.label: Contact
hero.title: Let’s talk about your content, your data and your systems
hero.subtitle: Research corpora, learning content, catalogues, announcements, archives or platform projects: tell us where you are, we’ll help you map the next step.

aside.title: A structured first exchange
aside.body: We first read your content, your constraints and your objectives. Then we get back to you with an initial response: key questions, framing options and implementation paths.

projects.title: Examples of projects
projects.body: These are typical situations where we can help. Yours may be simpler or more complex: what matters is a clear description of the context.

items.0: Structuring a corpus (languages, archives, announcements, catalogues, learning content) into a sustainable, exploitable database.
items.1: Connecting an existing platform to books, workbooks, exercise sheets, printable resources or other learning derivatives.
items.2: Designing a new ecosystem: data, interfaces, internal tools and derivatives (books, materials, apps) around a single foundation.

process.title: What happens next?
process.body: After your message, we move forward in clear steps, taking time to understand your content, audiences and constraints.

items.0: We read your description, sample content and constraints (budget, timeline, target audiences).
items.1: We get back to you with an initial response: key questions, framing ideas and possible implementation options.
items.2: If it makes sense for you, we schedule a more detailed call (video / phone) to refine scope, timeline and deliverables.

longoka.name: Longoka
longoka.oneLiner: Academy of sciences and letters — courses, immersions and learning materials.
longoka.description: Courses, articles, books, stationery and educational products — languages, scripts and knowledge in one learning environment.
longoka.meta: LMS platform where content is structured for reuse in course materials and publishing.

lexikongo.name: Lexikongo
lexikongo.description: Multilingual Kikongo lexical platform — lookup, research and derivatives. Courses live on Longoka.
lexikongo.meta: Reusable lexical engine for other languages or corpora.

lexilingala.name: Lexilingala
lexilingala.oneLiner: Online Lingala lexicon — courses are on Longoka.
lexilingala.description: Sister platform focused on Lingala, same foundation as Lexikongo. Lexicon only, not an LMS.
lexilingala.meta: Fast localization of a lexical engine for a new language.

madizi.name: Madizi
madizi.oneLiner: Death notices and ceremony information, with dignity.
madizi.description: Obituary and family or professional memory application, multilingual.
madizi.meta: Editorial system where notices and tributes are structured for consultation and preservation.

sonekeno.name: Sonekeno
sonekeno.oneLiner: Narrative creation — worlds and fiction (Les Derniers Léopards).
sonekeno.description: Writing workshop to structure characters, scenes, timelines and glossaries — fiction studio separate from Batina Media.
sonekeno.meta: Creative project in pre-production — transmedia narrative IP.
